Explanation:

Neither red nor green means it is blue Required probability = 8/26 = 4/13

description.text: The probability of drawing an odd-numbered card from a bag containing cards 1 to x is 1/2. Which of the following can be the possible value of x ?

properties.html: The probability of drawing an odd-numbered card from a bag containing cards 1 to x is 1/2. Which of the following can be the possible value of x ?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Since the bag contains cards numbered 1 to x and the probability of drawing an odd-numbered card is 1/2, the probability of drawing even-numbered card also becomes 1/2. Hence, there must be an equal number of odd and even - numbered cards. This is only possible when x = 6
